brief: Animated children's-presenter energy at roughly 70% intensity: clear, fully voiced speech, playful emphasis and engaged questions. Instructions stay steady; help stays encouraging; endings relax without whispering. Energy values are a creative brief, not a synthesis setting.
acceptedBy: User listened to the eight-line comparison (output/voice-energy-review) and asked for the revised voices to be implemented on 2026-10-20.
